page_title: VER 0-5 INT | Verona v Inter 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' The referee is firm and issues Marko Arnautovic (Inter) a deserved yellow card.
90+2' Joaquin Correa (Inter) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the crossbar!
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
88' Amin Sarr (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
87' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
84' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Marko Arnautovic (Inter) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
82' A pass from Tajon Buchanan (Inter) is intercepted by Lorenzo Montipo and the move breaks down.
81' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
79' Darko Lazovic (Verona) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Yann Sommer makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
75' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.
74' Substitution. Carlos Augusto will be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Inter).
73' Total attempts – 7:10. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:7.
70' Dani Silva (Verona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
69' Substitution. Casper Tengstedt makes way for Tomas Suslov (Verona).
66' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.

65' Dani Silva (Verona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Inter win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
65' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
62' Substitution. Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Davide Frattesi.
62' Here comes a substitution. Marcus Thuram is given a rest as he is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).

60' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a low shot from long range towards the middle of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a comfortable save to stop the effort.
59' Suat Serdar (Verona) sends a long cross over to Amin Sarr, but Yann Sommer comes forward to gather the ball.
58' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Inter couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
55' Reda Belahyane (Verona) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
52' Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) sends a long ball forward to Casper Tengstedt, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
50' Joaquin Correa almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.
46' Paolo Zanetti makes a switch. Amin Sarr is coming on in place of Daniel Mosquera (Verona) at the start of the second period.
46' Paolo Zanetti has made a change at the break. Darko Lazovic has come on in place of Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
46' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Daniele Ghilardi comes on the pitch for Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Abdou Harroui (Verona) comes off for Dani Silva.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Nicolo Barella (Inter) is replaced by Piotr Zielinski.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Suat Serdar (Verona) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked. Verona get a corner.
43' The Inter players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
41' 0 - 5 Goal - 0:5! Joaquin Correa tees up Yann Bisseck (Inter) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top right corner and past Lorenzo Montipo.
37' Yann Sommer leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).

37' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Verona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Domagoj Bradaric floats over the corner and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post.
35' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
35' 4:7 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:4.
33' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

31' 0 - 4 What a goal! Kristjan Asllani plays it to Stefan de Vrij (Inter), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Lorenzo Montipo into the left side of the goal. 0:4.
31' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sends it out of play.
30' Nicolo Barella (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
28' A snap shot from distance by Suat Serdar (Verona) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
27' Joaquin Correa (Inter) threads a pass through to Matteo Darmian, but Lorenzo Montipo breaks up the move.
25' 0 - 3 Marcus Thuram (Inter) is released by Alessandro Bastoni, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
24' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
22' 0 - 2 Joaquin Correa passes to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
21' A crossfield pass from Suat Serdar (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates.
20' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Yann Bisseck (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcus Thuram shows great vision to find Joaquin Correa (Inter) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
15' Stefan de Vrij comes onto the pitch because Francesco Acerbi (Inter) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
14' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
13' A player from Verona brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Inter will take a free kick.
12' Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
9' Carlos Augusto (Inter) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
8' What a chance that is! Joaquin Correa (Inter) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
7' Joaquin Correa (Inter) tries to find Nicolo Barella with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
6' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

5' Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
4' Andrea Colombo couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) and blew his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Verona.
2' Kristjan Asllani flicks on the near post corner to Marcus Thuram (Inter) at the back post, but he somehow heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
2' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
1' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.
1' The match has just started.
Inter will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
